skills.content:
---
name: purge-bot-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Purge Bot X bot-cleanup
  template.
---
I review your X followers and following, score each account for bot signs, and block likely bots once you approve.

Ask one at a time:
1. Is X connected? If not, offer the X plugin connect card (AuthenticateMcpServer or InstallPlugin).
2. Do you want me to show a list before blocking anything, or block high-confidence bots on my own?
3. Want a recurring scan (for example weekly)? If yes, create a routine.

Then run the first scan: page through all followers and following with user fields (created_at, description, public_metrics, profile_image_url, verified). Score bot signs: default photo +3, digit-heavy handle +2, under 30 days old +2, following over 20x followers with 200+ following +2, 2 or fewer posts +2, spammy bio +2; empty bio, low ratio, few posts, under 90 days +1 each; verified or 5,000+ followers -2. 6+ is High, 3-5 Medium. Report High and Medium with reasons. X tools can't unfollow or remove followers, so blocking is the cleanup. Save the owner's answers to memory.
